about_the_game:
🧠 ContentBuddy – Create Without Limits

ContentBuddy is your local-first AI creation studio.
No subscriptions. No cloud. No tracking. Just raw, offline creative power.

Built for indie creators, marketers, podcasters, solopreneurs, and tinkerers—ContentBuddy gives you a full-stack content engine right on your machine, powered by local AI models. Write scripts. Generate images. Transcribe and summarize audio. Add voiceovers. Create social-ready content from a single source file—all without ever touching the internet.

This isn’t SaaS.
This is your private AI production line, right on your desktop.

⚡ What Can It Do?

  • ✍️ Generate text with local LLMs (Mistral, LLaMA, DeepSeek, and more)

  • 🖼️ Create images using Stable Diffusion, with prompt control and upscaling

  • 🎤 Transcribe audio files using Whisper

  • 🔊 Convert text to speech with Silero or Piper TTS

  • 🎶 Generate sound effects and music using MusicGen or AudioLDM

  • 🧾 Extract data from documents with OCR (Tesseract)

  • 🎞️ Compile and remix into content with built-in post tools

  • 📂 Manage your content like Git, with project tracking and revision snapshots

Everything runs locally. No cloud APIs. No tokens.
If your machine can handle it, you’re the limit.

🛠️ Built for Builders

ContentBuddy was designed to be your AI assistant without the leash.
No locked ecosystems. No bandwidth dependencies. No hidden fees.

Whether you're batch-producing short-form clips, generating client deliverables, or just messing with models, ContentBuddy is your local sandbox—a stable, repeatable, and blazing-fast creative toolkit that stays out of your way.

🔐 Why Local Matters

Every click, word, and frame you generate is yours. No middleman, no data harvesting, no mystery black boxes.

ContentBuddy is for people who are tired of renting their intelligence.
Own your tools. Own your output. Own your workflow.

🚀 Key Features at a Glance

  • All-in-one local AI pipeline (text, image, audio, voice, OCR, more)

  • Fully offline. No internet connection required to use.

  • One-time purchase. No monthly fees.

  • Works on consumer GPUs and CPUs—optimized for speed and flexibility

  • Built-in model manager for easy hot-swapping of local models

  • Timeline-style content manager with versioning and export options

  • Simple UI, power-user underpinnings

Ready to stop feeding the algorithm and start building your own?

🧰 ContentBuddy: Your Intelligence. Your Machine. Your Rules.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: i5 - 4core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8gb VRAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: i7 - 16core
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 12GB VRAM
  • Storage: 400 GB available space
